clusterTexts: Park City Place, formerly the Holiday Inn, is located in downtown Bridgeport. This property features 97 beautifully renovated apartments just moments away from the Metro-North train station, the bus terminal, and the Port Jefferson Ferry, making daily commutes effortless.

While the units were recently renovated for market-rate rents, in partnership with the Department of Housing, they are now being converted into affordable housing. Upon arrival, you will be welcomed by a beautifully designed lobby. Each apartment features an open-concept living room connected to an eat-in kitchen, complete with granite countertops and top-of-the-line stainless-steel appliances. Additionally, all units are equipped with central air conditioning.
These apartments will be available in Downtown Bridgeport for households earning at or below 80% of the Area Median Income. The breakdown includes 51 one-bedroom units and 46 two-bedroom units.

include a combined laundry and lounge area, a fitness center, and controlled access. Park City Place offers a convenient lifestyle for those seeking the best of urban living in Bridgeport. A parking garage is also available for residents at a monthly charge.
